taxon.name: Lucanus cervus

default_photo.attribution: (c) Marek R. Swadzba, all rights reserved, uploaded by Marek R. Swadzba

taxon.wikipedia_summary: The European stag beetle (Lucanus cervus) is one of the best-known species of stag beetle (family Lucanidae) in Western Europe, and is the eponymous example of the genus. L. cervus is listed as Near Threatened by the IUCN Red List.
